translations.literal: That autumn the Jin divided troops to hold Two He prefectures and counties; only Zhongshan, Qingyuan prefecture, Bao, Mo, Xing, Mo prefecture, Ji, Ci, Jiang, and Xiang fell only after long resistance.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Jin divided troops to hold Two He prefectures; only Zhongshan, Qingyuan, Bao, Mo, Xing, Mozhou, Ji, Ci, Jiang, and Xiang fell after long resistance.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳朔，帝登舟幸淮甸。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi new moon: the emperor boarded ship to tour the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingsi new moon: the emperor boarded ship to tour the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太后至揚州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the empress reached Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the empress reached Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷諸路勸誘獻納錢物。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: every circuit’s urging of donated goods was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, every circuit’s urging of donated goods was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，罷諸路召募潰兵忠義等人，及寄居官擅集勤王兵者。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: every circuit’s recruitment of routed troops, loyalists, and others, and acting officials’ unauthorized rallying of loyalist armies, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, circuit recruitment of routed and loyalist troops and acting officials’ unauthorized loyalist levies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，募群盜能並滅賊眾者官之。

translations.literal: Day guiha: bandits who could jointly destroy a band were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiha, bandits who could jointly destroy a band were given office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以張浚論李綱不已，落綱觀文殿大學士，止奉宮祠。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because Zhang Jun kept attacking Li Gang, Gang was stripped of Literary Hall Grand Academician and left only palace service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, because Zhang Jun kept attacking Li Gang, Gang was stripped of Literary Hall Grand Academician and left only palace service.

sentences.zh: 知秀州兼權浙西提點刑獄趙叔近入杭州招撫陳通。

translations.literal: Xiuzhou prefect and acting western Zhe judicial intendant Zhao Shujin entered Hangzhou to reassure Chen Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuzhou prefect and acting western Zhe judicial intendant Zhao Shujin entered Hangzhou to reassure Chen Tong.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷帥府、要郡、次要郡新軍及水軍。

translations.literal: Day yichou: new armies and naval forces of commander headquarters, key prefectures, and secondary prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, new armies and naval forces of headquarters and key and secondary prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以王淵為杭州制置盜賊使，統制官張俊從行。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wang Yuan was made Hangzhou commissioner for arranging bandits; controller Zhang Jun followed on the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wang Yuan became Hangzhou bandit-arrangement commissioner; Zhang Jun followed on campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次泗州，幸普照寺。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the court halted at Sizhou and visited Puzhao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the court halted at Sizhou and visited Puzhao Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Venus was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次楚州寶應縣。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the court halted at Baoying county, Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the court halted at Baoying in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 後軍將孫琦等作亂，逼左正言盧臣中墮水死。

translations.literal: Rear-guard general Sun Qi and others mutinied and forced left rectifier Lu Chenzhong into the water to his death.
translations.idiomatic: Rear-guard general Sun Qi and others mutinied and forced left rectifier Lu Chenzhong into the water to his death.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命劉光世討鎮江叛兵。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Liu Guangshi was ordered to suppress Zhenjiang mutineers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Liu Guangshi was ordered to suppress Zhenjiang mutineers.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以光世為滁和濠州、江寧府界招捉盜賊制置使，禦營統制官苗傅為使司都統制。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Guangshi was made commissioner for capturing bandits on the Chuzhou–He–Hao and Jiangning border; Imperial Escort controller Miao Fu was made headquarters overall controller.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Guangshi became commissioner for capturing bandits on the Chuzhou–He–Hao and Jiangning border; Miao Fu became headquarters overall controller.

sentences.zh: 朝請郎李棫提舉廣西左、右兩江峒丁公事。

translations.literal: Court gentleman Li Yi was charged with the cave-office affairs of Guangxi’s left and right rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Court gentleman Li Yi was charged with cave-office affairs of Guangxi’s left and right rivers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至揚州，禁內侍統兵官相見。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the court reached Yangzhou; eunuch commanders of troops were forbidden to meet one another.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the court reached Yangzhou; eunuch troop commanders were forbidden to meet one another.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，王淵、張俊誘趙萬等，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Wang Yuan and Zhang Jun lured Zhao Wan and the rest and executed them all.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Yuan and Zhang Jun lured Zhao Wan and the rest and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，李綱鄂州居住。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: Li Gang resided at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuzi: Li Gang resided at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 真定軍賊張遇入池州，守臣滕祐棄城遁。

translations.literal: Zhending army-bandit Zhang Yu entered Chizhou; defender Teng You abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhending army-bandit Zhang Yu entered Chizhou; defender Teng You abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔雜犯死罪有疑及情理可憫者，撫諭官同提刑司酌情減降，先斷後聞。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict—for miscellaneous capital crimes of death where there was doubt or pity in circumstance, reassurance officials with judicial commissioners were to reduce sentences at discretion, execute first and report after.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, for doubtful or pitiable capital crimes, reassurance and judicial officials might reduce sentences at discretion, execute first, and report after.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣王倫等為金國通問使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wang Lun and others were sent as envoys to inquire of the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wang Lun and others were sent as envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以張愨為尚書左丞，工部尚書顏岐同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Zhang Chou was made left vice director; Works Minister Yan Qi associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhang Chou became left vice director and Works Minister Yan Qi associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曲赦應天府、毫、宿、揚、泗、楚州、高郵軍。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: a partial amnesty was granted for Yingtian prefecture, Bo, Su, Yang, Si, Chu, and Gaoyou Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, a partial amnesty was granted for Yingtian, Bo, Su, Yang, Si, Chu, and Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以張愨為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhang Chou was made secretariat vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Chou became secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以顏岐為尚書左丞兼權門下侍郎，御史中丞許景衡為右丞，刑部尚書郭三益同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Yan Qi was made left vice director and acting gate vice director; censor-in-chief Xu Jingheng right vice director; Punishments Minister Guo Sanyi associate military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yan Qi became left vice director and acting gate vice director, Xu Jingheng right vice director, and Guo Sanyi associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 權密州趙野棄城遁，軍校杜彥據州，追野，殺之。

translations.literal: Acting Mizhou Zhao Ye abandoned the city and fled; army controller Du Yan seized the prefecture, pursued Ye, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Mizhou Zhao Ye fled; army controller Du Yan seized the prefecture, pursued Ye, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命福建路增招弓手。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Fujian circuit was ordered to recruit more bowmen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Fujian was ordered to recruit more bowmen.

sentences.zh: 金人陷河間府。

translations.literal: The Jin took Hejian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Hejian.

sentences.zh: 是月，軍賊丁進圍壽春府，守臣康允之拒卻之。

translations.literal: That month army-bandit Ding Jin besieged Shouchun prefecture; defender Kang Yunzhi repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: That month army-bandit Ding Jin besieged Shouchun; Kang Yunzhi repelled him.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰朔，命從臣四員充講讀官，就內殿講讀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen new moon: four attendant officials were made lecture readers to lecture in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen new moon: four attendants were made lecture readers in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔諸路提刑司選官，即轉運司所在州類省試進士，以待親策。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict ordered circuit judicial commissioners to choose officials at transport headquarters to hold a provincial-style examination for jinshi, to await the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, judicial commissioners were ordered to hold a provincial-style jinshi examination at transport headquarters pending the palace exam.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王淵入杭州，執陳通等誅之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wang Yuan entered Hangzhou, seized Chen Tong and the rest, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wang Yuan entered Hangzhou, seized Chen Tong and the rest, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，青州敗將王定以兵作亂，殺帥臣曾孝序。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Qingzhou routed general Wang Ding mutinied with troops and killed commander Zeng Xiaoxu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Qingzhou routed general Wang Ding mutinied and killed commander Zeng Xiaoxu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，粘罕犯汜水關，西京留守孫昭遠遣將拒之，戰歿，昭遠將兵南遁，尋命部將王仔奉啟運宮神禦赴行在。

translations.literal: Day guiha: Nianhan attacked Sishui Pass; western capital defender Sun Zhaoyuan sent generals to resist; they died in battle; Zhaoyuan led troops south in flight; soon he ordered lieutenant Wang Zai to escort the Qiyun Palace spirit escorts to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On guiha, Nianhan attacked Sishui Pass; western capital defender Sun Zhaoyuan’s generals resisted and died; Zhaoyuan fled south and soon ordered Wang Zai to escort Qiyun Palace spirit escorts to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改授後父徽猷閣待制邢煥為光州觀察使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the emperor’s father-in-law, Imperial Writings attendant Xing Huan, was reassigned observation commissioner of Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor’s father-in-law, Imperial Writings attendant Xing Huan, was reassigned Guang observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔凡刑賞大政並經三省，其幹請墨敕行下者罪之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict—all great rewards and punishments must pass the Three Departments; those who sought private ink edicts were guilty.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, all great rewards and punishments had to pass the Three Departments; private ink edicts were criminal.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，張遇犯江州。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zhang Yu attacked Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhang Yu attacked Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金人圍棣州，守臣薑剛之固守，金兵解去。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Jin besieged Di prefecture; defender Jiang Gangzhi held firm and the Jin army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Jin besieged Di; Jiang Gangzhi held firm and the Jin withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，金人陷同州，守臣鄭驤死之。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Jin took Tong prefecture; defender Zheng Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Jin took Tong; defender Zheng Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 張遇犯黃州。

translations.literal: Zhang Yu attacked Huang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yu attacked Huang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，金人陷汝州，入西京。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Jin took Ru prefecture and entered the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Jin took Ru and entered the western capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金人陷華州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Jin took Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Jin took Hua.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，破潼關。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Tong Pass was broken.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Tong Pass fell.

sentences.zh: 河東經制使王𤫉自同州引兵遁入蜀。

translations.literal: Hedong commissioner-general Wang Qi fled from Tong into Shu with his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong commissioner-general Wang Qi fled from Tong into Shu with his troops.

sentences.zh: 丁進詣宗澤降。

translations.literal: Ding Jin came to Zong Ze and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Jin came to Zong Ze and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，增置廣西弓手以備邊。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: more Guangxi bowmen were added to guard the border.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, more Guangxi bowmen were added for border defense.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書黃潛厚為延康殿學士、同提舉措置財用。

translations.literal: Revenue Minister Huang Qianhou was made Extended-Kang Hall academician and associate head of financial arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Minister Huang Qianshan became Extended-Kang Hall academician and associate head of financial arrangements.
